title: Eight split information charts in a quadratic tower

claims.statement: For the explicit quadratic field-tower code (a,b)->(a,b,ab,a^3+lambda*b^3) and the radius-103 split-chart decoder with its fixed fallback, average block error for a uniform 1000-bit message and 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses is at most 109323247683769923/1000000000000000000.

experiments.purpose: Verify the field, exact admitted volume and collision-sharp error bound, primitive count comparison, memory range and sample split-chart updates.
